# Contract: handoff

Third-party skill from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) (MIT, Matt Pocock), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (A session handoff another agent can resume). The method is upstream. Category: planning. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Write a handoff file so a fresh agent can continue the conversation, with secrets redacted.

## Use it for
- "write a handoff for the next session"
- "I'm stopping, leave a note for the next agent"

## Not for
- an implementation plan (writing-plans)
- a design spec sheet

## Accepted inputs
The current conversation, and optionally what the next session is for.

## Deliverables
A handoff document in the OS temp directory.
